bufferStop.name: Rail buffer stop
bufferStop.description: Clamp-on standard-gauge buffer stop. Delivered, rigged, lifted onto an open track end, then fastened by a worker. Recoverable into a 2 × 2 m stockyard slot.

slab.name: Concrete slab
slab.description: 1 × 1 m paving slab. Up to 12 slabs per 1 m² physical stack (about 2.2 m high, including spacers).

rail.name: Rail panel
rail.description: 5 m panel; 1,435 mm gauge. Two-cell track footprint; 5 × 3 m storage slots include handling clearance. Stack up to eight panels with spacers (2.85 m high).

railCurve.name: Curved rail panel · 15°
railCurve.description: 20 m radius; 5.236 m arc, 1,435 mm gauge. Six separately lifted panels make a 90° curve. 6 × 3 m storage slot. Stack up to eight panels with spacers (2.85 m high).

railPoints.name: Turnout points module
railPoints.description: First 5 m of a 20 m modular turnout: stock rails, movable blades, sleepers, and a manual lever. Stack up to eight modules with spacers (2.85 m high).

railFrog.name: Turnout frog module
railFrog.description: Second diverging panel: crossing frog and guard rails. Lay a separate straight panel alongside. Stack up to eight modules with spacers (2.85 m high).

railClosure.name: Turnout closure module
railClosure.description: Third diverging panel: closure rails. Lay a separate straight panel alongside. Stack up to eight modules with spacers (2.85 m high).

railExit.name: Turnout exit module
railExit.description: Fourth diverging panel: grid-aligned exit 5 m from the through track. Lay a separate straight panel alongside. Stack up to eight modules with spacers (2.85 m high).

office.name: Office container
office.description: 6 × 3 m office with steps and windows. Requires paved foundations.

sanitary.name: Sanitary container
sanitary.description: 3 × 2 m WC and showers. Water service required for operation.

shed.name: Equipment shed kit
shed.description: Build an 8 × 6 m open shed. Pillars, bracing, and corrugated roof.

engineShed.name: Engine shed kit
engineShed.description: 6 × 14 m drive-through locomotive shed. Delivered columns, roof frames, eight roof sections, four side-wall panels and two raised roller doors; 5.1 m clear height and connected internal track required. Erected by an excavator and construction crew.

processTank.name: 30,000 L process tank kit
processTank.description: Vertical modular steel tank. Crew bolts the base, lifts three shell courses, fits roof and nozzles, then inspects it. Requires a 4 × 4 m paved foundation.

transferPump.name: Rail liquid transfer pump kit
transferPump.description: Motor, pump, manifold and baseplate. Erected and connected by equipment and crew on a 2 × 2 m foundation.

processPipe.name: DN100 process pipe · 1 m
processPipe.description: One meter of raised DN100 process pipe, including support footing and bolted flange connections.

pipeElbow.name: DN100 process elbow
pipeElbow.description: Raised 90 degree elbow with support footing and flange bolts. Rotate to select the two connected edges.

pipeTee.name: DN100 process tee
pipeTee.description: Raised three-way pipe junction, support footing and three bolted flanges.

processValve.name: DN100 manual isolation valve
processValve.description: Supported handwheel valve with two flanges. A worker turns the installed handwheel to guide flow.

processGauge.name: DN100 pressure gauge section
processGauge.description: Supported inline pressure gauge section with local dial, two flanges and process monitoring.

store.name: Stores building kit
store.description: Build a 6 × 4 m workshop and stores building.

lamp.name: Light pole kit
lamp.description: 6 m pole, base and lamp. Requires paving and electricity.

diesel.name: Diesel drum · 200 L
diesel.description: A physical 200 L drum. Empty drums remain in storage.

fence.name: Fence panel
fence.description: 3 m fence panel with posts; marks a 3 × 1 m strip.

excavator.name: EX-6 tracked excavator
excavator.description: 6 t lift capacity. Carries every starter kit. Arrives fueled.

forklift.name: FL-25 rough-terrain forklift
forklift.description: 2.5 t lift capacity. Handles slabs, rail panels, poles and fuel.

railDriver.name: Qualified railway driver
railDriver.description: Licensed shunter driver. Arrives by crew bus and works an assigned shift.

builder.name: Construction worker
builder.description: Installs paving, rails and buildings. Arrives by crew bus.

operator.name: Equipment operator
operator.description: Drives excavators and forklifts; handles construction lifts.

engineer.name: Site engineer
engineer.description: Installs site infrastructure; can also perform construction work.

power.name: Electrical connection
power.description: Utility crew installs a 16 kVA site connection. Lights are wired during installation.

water.name: Water and sewer connection
water.description: Utility crew brings a small excavator and connects site water and sewer.
